entities.summary: Henry Gurney, a notable figure in the history of Malaysia, associated with Japanese Occupation and Malayan Emergency (1948–1960). Preceded by Malayan Emergency and Malaya achieves independence (Merdeka) under Tunku Abdul Rahman. Their legacy influenced Singapore expelled from Malaysia.
